'''Nurstin''' was rocky and gas-covered. It was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]] which was located in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. A number of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colonies were established by [[Messert Mines Corporation]] around the planet during the last century of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its red [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was discovered by [[Arnoth Draenell]] to have brilliant flashes of light sparkling its face, and it was later discovered to be rich in [[Corthel]] and [[Cortheum]].
